analyses.configuration:
[main]
mongo_ip: 127.0.0.1
mongo_port: 1812
imagefolder : replication/data/src
croppedfolder : replication/data/cropped
maskfolder : replication/data/mask
splittedfolder : replication/data/splitted
picklefolder : replication/data/dumps
picklefusionfolder : replication/data/fusion_dumps
fusionfolder: replication/data/fusion
ntfy_topic: robidfz_ntfy

[general]
epsilon_ndvi: 1e-6

[area]
areaofinterest_earth : [(36.855436257385257,-1.36221167184415),(36.873889855407718,-1.36221167184415),(36.873889855407718,-1.340202222173801),(36.855436257385257,-1.340202222173801)]
areaofinterest_image : [(2550, 170), (6200, 170), (6200, 4270), (2550, 4270)]
imagetype: .jpg
channels: plain, blue, ndvi_exg
image_scaling: 0.2

[sam]
sam_model: models/sam_vit_h_4b8939.pth,vit_h
sam_platform: cpu
points_per_side: 32
min_mask_quality: 0.8
min_mask_stability: 0.9
layers: 1
crop_n_points_downscale_factor: 2
min_mask_region_area: 100

[filters]
filters: min_roundness, max_roundness, min_iou, max_iou, min_stability, max_stability, min_pixels, max_pixels
min_roundness: 0.7
max_roundness: 0.9
min_iou: 0.8
max_iou: 1
min_stability: 0.9
max_stability: 1
min_pixels: 10
max_pixels: 1000

[fusion]
masters: plain
slaves: blue, ndvi_exg
inter_slave_operator: any
inter_master_operator: all
fusion_channel: fusion
th1:0.05
th2:0.95

[control]
save_images: True
clean_images: True
clean_pickles: True
